purpose: OPTIONAL high-resolution ground photograph over one rectangle, drawn only near the camera. Not part of the first load: nothing fetches this until the viewer asks.
note: Same CRS as heightfield.json, because the source is published in it - so there is no reprojection anywhere in this path and none of the 215 m ED50/WGS84 datum shift.
levelOrder: coarsest first, like basemap.json and heighttier.json - so a viewer that walks the list forwards and stops when it has had enough lands on the coarsest affordable one.
